data.description: The Fun Cycle is an outdoor exercise cycle with an orange seat and an orange steering wheel. The user pedals in a seated position, which gives a steady leg and cardio workout without the impact of running. Older residents often like it because it feels familiar, and it suits people who walk in the park and want a few minutes of sitting exercise in between. It is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range for parks, societies and walking tracks. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. We will confirm both for the Fun Cycle in your quote, with our standard terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Send us your open gym plan and we will add it.

items.pText: The Fun Cycle is an outdoor exercise cycle with an orange seat and an orange steering wheel. The user pedals in a seated position, which gives a steady leg and cardio workout without the impact of running. Older residents often like it because it feels familiar, and it suits people who walk in the park and want a few minutes of sitting exercise in between. It is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range for parks, societies and walking tracks. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. We will confirm both for the Fun Cycle in your quote, with our standard terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Send us your open gym plan and we will add it.

Pedals and cranks turn on bearings, so they need checking and greasing at each service, especially after the rains. The Fun Cycle frame can be bolted self-standing or grouted. Place the cycle where the pedals cannot catch anyone walking past, and keep the seat dry and clean.
